summary: Learn BPMN 2.0 modelling to map workflows, validate process logic, and support automation. Enrol for practical hands-on training.
lede: BPMN 2.0 business process modelling helps you represent process flows, decisions, events, responsibilities, and handoffs in a clear, standardized format. This course develops practical skills in process scoping, notation accuracy, lane assignment, gateway logic, and model validation. Through applied diagramming, you will build and review BPMN 2.0 models using events, tasks, gateways, pools, lanes, data objects, and message flows. You will also practise process decomposition, exception mapping, and the creation of review-ready as-is and to-be models that support process improvement, workflow automation, and stakeholder collaboration.
audienceIntro: This BPMN 2.0 business process modelling training is designed for professionals who need to document operational workflows clearly, improve process design, and support automation or governance discussions with accurate models.
prerequisites: Participants should have a working understanding of how business processes operate in their own function and basic familiarity with process documentation. No programming is required. A laptop is recommended for diagramming exercises, and prior exposure to business analysis, operations, quality improvement, or workflow design will help you move faster through the applied work.
